x: Another newcomer, Dylan McDermott, provided us with a unique double, winning the 'B' pole vault - again in a season's best of 4.70 metres - behind the ubiquitous Mike Edwards who somehow managed 5.25 metres despite a stomach muscle pull.

Leith Marar won both the shot and discus, and Andy Hutchinson the high jump - all with first class performances - while the gutsiest performance went to Dylan McDermott who vaulted to silver with a broken finger.
